# 3. Functional and biogeochemical reprogramming

## 3.1 KEGG pathway abundance and temporal trends

```{r kegg-temporal-trends}
# absolute abundance of KEGG
data <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "plot-out", "SD-SI-kegg.txt"),
                     sep = '\t', check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "plot-out", "meta-data.txt"),
                   sep = '\t', check.names = FALSE)

head(data)

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 读入
data <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "plot-out", "SD-SI-kegg.txt"),
                   sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "plot-out", "meta-data.txt"),
                       sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

# 颜色
cat_cols <- c(
  "Amino acid metabolism"                 = "#30426D",
  "Cellular processes"                    = "#DEA63B",
  "Central metabolism"                    = "#7CAE00",
  "Cofactors & Secondary metabolism"      = "#2e7d32",
  "Environmental information processing"  = "#DA3C34",
  "Genetic information processing"        = "#00A9FF",
  "Lipid & Glycan metabolism"             = "#807138",
  "Transport & Xenobiotics"               = "#1B8A73"
)

# 年份顺序
year_levels <- c("SD","11","12","14","15","17")

meta_cols <- c("type","pathway","name")
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(data), meta_cols)

# 1) long table: pathway x sample
dat_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_cols), names_to = "seqid", values_to = "hits") %>%
  mutate(
    seqid = as.character(seqid),
    hits  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(hits))
  ) %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% mutate(seqid = as.character(seqid)), by = "seqid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(DNA), !is.na(total_reads), !is.na(hits)) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = factor(as.character(group), levels = year_levels),
    # CPM/RPM: counts per million reads
    cpm = (hits / total_reads) * 1e6,
    # DNA-weighted CPM (proxy)
    dna_w = cpm * DNA * 50,
    # 为了画图更稳：log10( +1 )，避免 0/极小值爆炸
    y = log10(dna_w)
  )

# 2) summary line per category (name)
sum_name <- dat_long %>%
  group_by(name, Year) %>%
  summarise(y_med = median(y, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3) plot
 ggplot(dat_long, aes(x = Year, y = y)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = pathway, color = name), alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(group = pathway, color = name), alpha = 0.50, size = 0.6) +
  geom_line(
    data = sum_name,
    aes(x = Year, y = y_med, group = name, color = name),
    linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = sum_name,
    aes(x = Year, y = y_med, color = name),
    size = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cat_cols, breaks = names(cat_cols), drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "log10( KEGG CPM × DNA)",
    color = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text()
  )  +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = 'black')) +
   theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = 'black')) 

 
 ggsave(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "plot-out", "sd-si-kegg-abun.pdf"),
         width = 5, height = 4)

```

## 3.2 SD vs SI (11–17) KEGG

```{r heatmap_bubble_plot}

## SD vs SI (11–17) KEGG heatmap
## GLM trend within SI + top pathways per class (scheme A)
## Order within each class: NotSig -> Decreasing -> Increasing, then |beta| desc
## Pathway label color = GLM trend

library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# 0) read

df <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "plot-out", "SD-SI-kegg.txt"),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 check.names = FALSE,   # 关键
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
metadata <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "plot-out", "meta-data.txt"),
                   sep = '\t', check.names = FALSE)


meta_cols <- c("pathway","type","name")

num_idx  <- which(!colnames(df) %in% meta_cols)
num_cols <- colnames(df)[num_idx]  # 包含重复 SD/11/...

new_cols <- paste0(num_cols, "__", seq_along(num_cols))
colnames(df)[num_idx] <- new_cols

col_map <- tibble(col = new_cols,
                  Year = sub("__.*$", "", new_cols))

to_num <- function(x){
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[\u00A0\u2007\u202F]", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)
  x <- gsub("^<", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[^0-9eE\\.\\+\\-]", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

year_levels <- c("SD","11","12","14","15","17")
si_years    <- c("11","12","14","15","17")

dat_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(new_cols), names_to = "col", values_to = "raw") %>%
  left_join(col_map, by = "col") %>%
  mutate(
    value = to_num(raw),
    Year  = factor(Year, levels = year_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  select(pathway, type, name, Year, value)


# 1) z-score (per pathway across ALL samples)

dat_long <- dat_long %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  mutate(
    mu  = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sdv = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    z   = ifelse(is.na(sdv) | sdv == 0, NA_real_, (value - mu) / sdv)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2) GLM within SI(11–17): beta + p + BH + adjR2

min_total_n <- 12
min_years   <- 3

glm_res <- dat_long %>%
  filter(Year %in% si_years) %>%
  mutate(Year_num = as.numeric(as.character(Year))) %>%
  group_by(name, pathway) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x %>% filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(Year_num))
    n_eff  <- nrow(d)
    n_year <- n_distinct(d$Year_num)
    if (n_eff < min_total_n || n_year < min_years) {
      return(tibble(n = n_eff, n_year = n_year, beta = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, adj_r2 = NA_real_))
    }
    fit <- lm(value ~ Year_num, data = d)
    sm  <- summary(fit)
    tibble(
      n = n_eff,
      n_year = n_year,
      beta = unname(coef(fit)[["Year_num"]]),
      p = sm$coefficients["Year_num","Pr(>|t|)"],
      adj_r2 = sm$adj.r.squared
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = ifelse(is.na(p), NA_real_, p.adjust(p, method = "BH")),
    trend = case_when(
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05 & beta > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05 & beta < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE                                    ~ "NotSig"
    ),
    abs_beta = abs(replace_na(beta, 0))
  )


# 3) 每个大类(name)只保留 top4 (按 abs(beta))
#    同时：类内排序 NotSig -> Decreasing -> Increasing；各组内 abs(beta) desc

top_n <- 4
trend_rank <- c("NotSig" = 1, "Decreasing" = 3, "Increasing" = 2)

keep_tbl <- glm_res %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_beta), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%          # 每类 top4 abs(beta)
  ungroup()

# 重新做“最终显示顺序”
order_tbl <- keep_tbl %>%
  mutate(trend_rank = trend_rank[trend]) %>%
  arrange(name, trend_rank, desc(abs_beta), pathway)

path_levels <- order_tbl %>% pull(pathway)
name_levels <- order_tbl %>% pull(name) %>% unique()


# 4) Heatmap aggregation: median(z) per Year + Δ(17-SD)

min_n_per_group <- 3

agg <- dat_long %>%
  semi_join(keep_tbl %>% select(name, pathway), by = c("name","pathway")) %>%
  filter(Year %in% year_levels) %>%
  group_by(name, pathway, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_eff = sum(!is.na(z)),
    z_med = ifelse(n_eff >= min_n_per_group, median(z, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Year = factor(Year, levels = year_levels))

agg_wide <- agg %>%
  select(name, pathway, Year, z_med) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = z_med)

agg_delta <- agg_wide %>%
  transmute(
    name, pathway,
    Year  = "Δ(17-SD)",
    z_med = `17` - SD
  )

heat_df <- bind_rows(
  agg,
  agg_delta %>% mutate(Year = factor(Year, levels = c(year_levels, "Δ(17-SD)")))
) %>%
  mutate(
    Year    = factor(as.character(Year), levels = c(year_levels, "Δ(17-SD)")),
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = path_levels),
    name    = factor(name, levels = name_levels)
  )


# 5) 星号：Wilcoxon SD vs 17（加在 Δ列）

min_wilcox_n_each <- 5

wilcox_res <- dat_long %>%
  semi_join(keep_tbl %>% select(name, pathway), by = c("name","pathway")) %>%
  filter(Year %in% c("SD","17")) %>%
  mutate(G2 = factor(Year, levels = c("SD","17"))) %>%
  group_by(name, pathway) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x %>% filter(!is.na(value))
    n_sd <- sum(d$G2 == "SD")
    n_17 <- sum(d$G2 == "17")
    if (n_sd < min_wilcox_n_each || n_17 < min_wilcox_n_each) {
      return(tibble(p = NA_real_))
    }
    wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(value ~ G2, data = d, exact = FALSE))
    tibble(p = wt$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = ifelse(is.na(p), NA_real_, p.adjust(p, method = "BH")),
    star  = ifelse(!is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05, "*", "")
  )

star_df <- wilcox_res %>%
  filter(star == "*") %>%
  transmute(
    name,
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = path_levels),
    Year    = factor("Δ(17-SD)", levels = levels(heat_df$Year)),
    label   = star
  )


# 6) pathway 行名字颜色：按 GLM trend（沿用全文配色）

col_inc <- "#E3AF2E"
col_dec <- "#14A6B1"
col_ns  <- "#222222"

label_df <- keep_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = path_levels),
    lab_col = case_when(
      trend == "Increasing" ~ col_inc,
      trend == "Decreasing" ~ col_dec,
      TRUE                  ~ col_ns
    ),
    label = sprintf("<span style='color:%s'>%s</span>", lab_col, as.character(pathway))
  ) %>%
  arrange(pathway)

label_map <- setNames(label_df$label, as.character(label_df$pathway))


# 7) Plot A：Heatmap（不显示 strip，右侧单独 panel 放类名并左对齐）

fill_pal <- colorRampPalette(c("#80cbc4", "#F3F6EC", "#ffa000"))(100)

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = Year, y = pathway, fill = z_med)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(data = star_df, aes(x = Year, y = pathway, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2,  vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5,,color = "black") +
  facet_grid(name ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) label_map[x]) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = fill_pal,
    limits  = c(-3, 3),
    oob     = scales::squish,
    name    = "Median z-score"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),     # ✅ 主图不显示右侧类名
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
p_heat
# 右侧类名 panel（严格左对齐）
# 关键：用同样的 facet 顺序 (name_levels)，每个 facet 放一个 text，hjust=0
name_panel_df <- tibble(
  name = factor(name_levels, levels = name_levels),
  x = 1, y = 1, lab = as.character(name_levels)
)

p_name <- ggplot(name_panel_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab)) +
  geom_text(hjust = 0,  size = 4) +
  facet_grid(name ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 10), clip = "off") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 0)
  )

# 拼起来：左热图 + 右类名
final_plot <- p_heat + p_name + plot_layout(widths = c(8.6, 2))
final_plot

ggsave(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "plot-out", "sd-si-kegg-glm-heat_top4.pdf"),
       final_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
```

## 3.3 Functional maptree

```{r maptree}

library(utils)
library(devtools)
library(igraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(data.tree)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggtree)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggraph)

data_to_maptree = function(otu,tax,N){
## 依赖包

# 导入功能函数
vegan_otu <-  function(physeq){
  OTU <-  otu_table(physeq)
  if(taxa_are_rows(OTU)){
    OTU <-  t(OTU)
  }
  return(as(OTU,"matrix"))
}
vegan_tax <-  function(physeq){
  tax <-  tax_table(physeq)
  
  return(as(tax,"matrix"))
}
ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(otu, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), 
               tax_table(tax)
)
#相对丰富转换
ps1_rela  = transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x) );ps1_rela 
# 提取otu表格
otu_table = as.data.frame(t(vegan_otu(ps1_rela)))
otu_table$mean = rowMeans(otu_table)
otu_table$ID = row.names(otu_table)
head(otu_table)
#按照从大到小排序
otu_table<- arrange(otu_table, desc(mean))
subtab = head(otu_table,N)
head(subtab)
row.names(subtab) =subtab$ID
subtab = subtab[,1:(dim(subtab)[2]-2)]
subtab = as.matrix(subtab)

#对phyloseq取子集
ps_sub <- phyloseq(otu_table(subtab, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), 
                   tax_table(tax))
ps_sub
# 整理tax文件
#注意本次制作的是OTU水平的maptree, 将species level 标记为了OTU or ASV
tax = as.data.frame(vegan_tax(ps_sub))
#添加水平识别标示
tax$upkingdom = paste("U_",tax$upkingdom,sep = "--")
tax$Kingdom = paste(tax$upkingdom,"D_",tax$Kingdom,sep = "--")
tax$Phylum = paste(tax$Kingdom,"P_",tax$Phylum,sep = "--")
tax$Class = paste(tax$Phylum,"C_",tax$Class,sep = "--")
tax$classlow = paste(tax$Class,"O_",tax$classlow,sep = "--")
tax$OTU = paste("ASV",row.names(tax),sep = "--")
# # 对不同分类水平的tax未知物种进行区分
tax_table(ps_sub) = as.matrix(tax)
head(tax)

# 构造边文件
#提取分组信息
Desep_group <- as.character(colnames(tax))
#按照form--to格式来排布数据
edge_t = tax[c(Desep_group[1:2])]
dim(edge_t)
edge_t <-  dplyr::distinct(edge_t)
dim(edge_t)
for (i in 2:5) {
  result = tax[c(Desep_group[i:(i+1)])]
  colnames(result) = colnames(edge_t)
  result <-  dplyr::distinct(result)
  edge_t = rbind(edge_t,result)
}
dim(edge_t)
colnames(edge_t) = c("from","to")
if (length(unique(tax$Kingdom)) >1) {
  edge_t$from = as.character(edge_t$from)
  edge_t$to = as.character(edge_t$to)
  buc = data.frame(from = c("king_up","king_up"),to =c("D_Archaea","D_Bacteria") )
  row.names(buc) = c("sp_K","sp_k1")
  deg = rbind(edge_t,buc)
}
deg = edge_t
# 构造基本节点信息文件
#构造tree用于提取分级结构
tree <- FromDataFrameNetwork(deg)
vertices_t  <-  data.frame(
  name = unique(c(as.character(deg$from), as.character(deg$to)))
)
# Then I can easily get the level of each node, and add it to the initial data frame:
mylevels <- data.frame( name=tree$Get('name'), level=tree$Get("level") )
vertices_t <- vertices_t %>% 
  left_join(., mylevels, by=c("name"="name"))
#这里提取名称信息
AA = rep("A",length(vertices_t$name))
for (i in 1:length(vertices_t$name)) {
  AA [i] = strsplit(basename(as.character(vertices_t$name)), "--")[[i]][length(strsplit(basename(as.character(vertices_t$name)), "--")[[i]])]
}
vertices_t$shortName<- AA
# #设置level为3的定义为标签，其他偶读都省略掉，避免杂乱无章
vertices_t <- vertices_t %>%
  mutate(new_label=ifelse(level==3, shortName, NA))
row.names(vertices_t) = vertices_t$name



# 构造网络文件
mygraph <- graph_from_data_frame( deg, vertices= vertices_t )

p=ggraph(mygraph, layout = 'circlepack',sort.by = NULL, direction = "out") + 
  geom_node_circle(aes(fill = as.factor(depth),color = as.factor(depth)),size=0.01) +
  scale_fill_manual(values= c("#CD3774","#506DAD","#602725","#A8683A","#CC9C40","#F0962D") ) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("0" = NA, "1" = NA, "2" = NA, "3" = NA, "4"= NA, 
                             "5"= NA)) +
  #  scale_color_manual( values=c("0" = "white", "1" = "black", "2" = "black", "3" = "black", "4"="black", "5"="black", "6"="black", "7"="black","8"="black", "9"="black") ) +
 # geom_node_text( aes(label=new_label), size=4,repel = TRUE,color='red') +
  # geom_node_label( aes(label=new_label), size=3,repel = TRUE) +
  theme_void() + 
  theme( legend.position="FALSE",plot.margin = unit(rep(0,4), "cm")) +
  coord_fixed()


return(list(p,deg,vertices_t,ps_sub,mygraph))
}

maptree_add2_plot = function(x,fillcolor ){
  #解析输入
  ps_sub = mapdata[[4]]
  vertices_t = mapdata[[3]]
  deg = mapdata[[2]]
  # ps_sub = ps_sub
  #vertices_t = vertices_t
  #deg = deg
  fillcolor="levels"
  # 防止合并后名称改变
  fillcolor = paste("addtab",fillcolor,sep = "_")
  colnames(addtab) = paste("addtab",colnames(addtab),sep = "_")
  vegan_otu <-  function(physeq){
    OTU <-  otu_table(physeq)
    if(taxa_are_rows(OTU)){
      OTU <-  t(OTU)
    }
    return(as(OTU,"matrix"))
  }
  vegan_tax <-  function(physeq){
    tax <-  tax_table(physeq)
    
    return(as(tax,"matrix"))
  }
  
  tax_table = as.data.frame(vegan_tax(ps_sub))
  otu_table = as.data.frame(t(vegan_otu(ps_sub)))
  #计算全部均值
  otu_table$mean = rowMeans(otu_table)
  #组合结果
  inde = merge(otu_table,tax_table,by = "row.names", all = TRUE)
  head(inde)
  row.names(inde) = inde$Row.names
  inde$Row.names = NULL
  
  dim(inde)
  inde = merge(inde,addtab,by = "row.names",all.x = TRUE)
  row.names(inde) = inde$Row.names
  inde$Row.names = NULL
  dim(inde)
  #更改颜色列统一为fill_color

  #添加高级注释信息进入函数
  row.names(inde) = paste("ASV",row.names(inde),sep = "--")
  ##将全部信息合并到节点属性中

  row.names(data_plot) = data_plot$Row.names

  head(data_plot)

  # data_plot$mean[!is.na(asa)] = sqrt(data_plot$mean[!is.na(asa)])
  
  mygraph <- graph_from_data_frame( deg, vertices= data_plot )
  # 设置颜色映射参数
  data = create_layout(mygraph, layout = 'circlepack',weight = mean, sort.by = NULL, direction = "out")
  colnames(data)
  i = "fill_color" 
  data[[i]] = as.character(data[[i]])
  data[[i]][is.na(data[[i]])] = "NOTA"
  unique(data[[i]])
  data[[i]] = factor(data[[i]],levels =unique(data[[i]]) )
  levels(data[[i]])
  data[i] = data[[i]]
  colbar <-length(unique(data[[i]]))
  mi = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")
  # mi = c( "#E41A1C", "#377EB8" ,"#4DAF4A",'#FFFFFF')
  fil_colors = mi[1:colbar ]
  #fil_colors = c( "#E41A1C", "#377EB8" ,"#4DAF4A",'#FFFFFF')
 names(fil_colors ) = unique(data$fill_color)
 fil_colors
 # fil_colors[1]= NA
  p = ggraph(mygraph, layout = 'circlepack',weight = mean, sort.by = NULL,direction = "out") +
    geom_node_circle(aes(fill = factor(fill_color),color = as.factor(depth)) ,size =0.5) +
 #  scale_fill_manual(values= fil_colors ) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("0" = alpha("#beaed4",1), 
                                "1" = alpha("#e0e0e0",0.7),
```

## 3.4 Correlations with physicochemical properties

```{r dbRDA_cycling}

library(vegan)
library(adespatial)
library(tidyverse)

func <-  read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "ecology", "model_env", "pathway.txt"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1,header = T,
                       sep = "\t")

env <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "ecology", "model_env", "eco_stat_cgf.txt"),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1,header = T,
                  sep = "\t")
func <- func[,-c(1)]
env <- env[,-c(1:8)]

View(func_hel)
View(env)

func_hel <- decostand(func, method = 'hellinger')

rda.data = func_hel
env <- env[,-c(37:41)]


mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist = "bray", data = env) #using add = TRUE option will give different results, more variables
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist = "bray", data = env)
step.res.db.all = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000, pin = 0.05) #about 35.5% explained  
all.select.db = env[, attributes(step.res.db.all$terms)$term.labels]
all.select.db 

#GLM
library(MuMIn)
library(hier.part)
library(relaimpo)
library(ggtern)
library(ggalt)

relaimp.df = data.frame(matrix(nrow=ncol(all.select.db)))

#  relaimp.df = data.frame(matrix(ncol=1))
# relaimp.df = data.frame(matrix(nrow=1))

relaimp.rsq = c()
relaimp.adjrsq = c()
relaimp.p = c()
relaimp.var.y = c()

for (name in colnames(func_hel)){
  print(name)
  lm.fit = lm(func_hel[,name]~., data=all.select.db)
  lm.rela = calc.relimp(lm.fit, type = c("lmg"), rela = TRUE) #this function actually has a groups option to combine variables into groups
  relaimp.df = cbind(relaimp.df, lm.rela@lmg)
  relaimp.var.y = c(relaimp.var.y, lm.rela@var.y)
  lm.summary = summary(lm.fit)
  relaimp.rsq = c(relaimp.rsq, lm.summary$r.squared)
  relaimp.adjrsq = c(relaimp.adjrsq, lm.summary$adj.r.squared)
  relaimp.p = c(relaimp.p, pf(lm.summary$fstatistic[1], lm.summary$fstatistic[2], lm.summary$fstatistic[3], lower.tail=F))
}

relaimp.df = relaimp.df[, -1]
colnames(relaimp.df) = colnames(func_hel)
relaimp.df = relaimp.df * 100
relaimp.df.final = rbind(relaimp.df, R2 = relaimp.rsq, adjR2 = relaimp.adjrsq, p = relaimp.p, yvar = relaimp.var.y)
relaimp.df.final = rbind(relaimp.df.final, padjust = p.adjust(relaimp.df.final["p",], method="fdr"))
relaimp.df.fin = t.data.frame(relaimp.df.final)
relaimp.df.fin = as.data.frame(relaimp.df.fin)
```

## 3.5 Mediation analysis

```{r mediation_analysis}
 library(dplyr)
 library(stringr)

 df_meta <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "mediation", "metadata.txt"),
                   row.names = 1, sep = '\t',header = T,stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
 
 df_g <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "meta", "mpa_profile_genus.txt"),
                   row.names = 1, sep = '\t',header = T,stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

 ## 1) 只选 SI 样本
 meta_si <- df_meta %>%
   as.data.frame() %>%
   tibble::rownames_to_column("SeqID") %>%
   mutate(SeqID = as.character(SeqID)) %>%
   filter(type == "SI")
 
 ## 2) 从 df_g 列名提取 SeqID（下划线前数字），并只保留 SI 的列
 # df_g 的列名类似： "109_FKDL210119808-1a"
 col_seqid <- str_extract(colnames(df_g), "^[0-9]+")
 names(col_seqid) <- colnames(df_g)
 
 si_seqid <- meta_si$SeqID
 keep_cols <- names(col_seqid)[col_seqid %in% si_seqid]
 
 # 子集：只保留 SI 样本列
 g_si <- df_g[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
 
 # 重命名列：用 SeqID 作为列名，便于后面对齐
 colnames(g_si) <- col_seqid[keep_cols]
 
 ## 3) 对齐样本顺序（按 meta_si 顺序），并丢弃缺失样本
 common_ids <- intersect(meta_si$SeqID, colnames(g_si))
 meta_si <- meta_si %>% filter(SeqID %in% common_ids)
 g_si <- g_si[, meta_si$SeqID, drop = FALSE]   # 按 meta 顺序排列列
 
 ## 4) 只保留 Bacteria / Archaea / Fungi（从 clade 的 d__xxx 判断）
 # df_g 的行名是 clade
 clade <- rownames(g_si)
 domain <- str_match(clade, "^d__([^|]+)")[,2]
 
 keep_domain <- domain %in% c("Bacteria", "Archaea", "Fungi")
 g_si <- g_si[keep_domain, , drop = FALSE]
 clade <- rownames(g_si)
 
 ## 5) 从 clade 抽取 genus（g__），并聚合到 genus 层级
 genus <- str_match(clade, "\\|g__([^|]+)")[,2]
 genus[is.na(genus) | genus == "" | genus == "unclassified" | genus == "Unclassified"] <- "Unclassified"
 
 # 可选：去掉 Unclassified（推荐，想保留）
 keep_genus <- genus != "Unclassified"
 g_si2 <- g_si[keep_genus, , drop = FALSE]
 genus2 <- genus[keep_genus]
 
 # 聚合：同一 genus 多行求和
 g_genus_counts <- rowsum(as.matrix(g_si2), group = genus2, reorder = FALSE)
 g_genus_counts <- as.data.frame(g_genus_counts, check.names = FALSE)
 
 ## 6) prevalence 过滤：在 >=10% 样本中 count>0
 n <- ncol(g_genus_counts)
 prev <- rowSums(g_genus_counts > 0) / n
 g_genus_filt <- g_genus_counts[prev >= 0.10, , drop = FALSE]
 
 ## 7) （可选）再加一个 abundance 过滤：总 counts 很低的 genus 去掉
 # 例如：总counts >= 10（按数据量可调）
# g_genus_filt <- g_genus_filt[rowSums(g_genus_filt) >= 10, , drop = FALSE]
 
 ## 8) 输出两个版本：counts / relative abundance
 g_genus_ra <- sweep(g_genus_filt, 2, colSums(g_genus_filt), FUN = "/")
 
 ## 9) （可选）CLR 变换：后续做线性/中介更稳
 # 伪计数建议用 0.5 或 1（看稀疏程度）
 pseudocount <- 0.5
 X <- as.matrix(g_genus_filt) + pseudocount
 X_ra <- sweep(X, 2, colSums(X), "/")
 clr <- function(mat) {
   logm <- log(mat)
   gm <- colMeans(logm)
   sweep(logm, 2, gm, "-")
 }
 g_genus_clr <- as.data.frame(clr(X_ra), check.names = FALSE)
 
 ## 10) 最终：meta_si + 微生物矩阵（转置成 sample x genus 更方便建模）
 micro_counts <- as.data.frame(t(g_genus_filt), check.names = FALSE)  # samples x genus
 micro_ra     <- as.data.frame(t(g_genus_ra),   check.names = FALSE)
 micro_clr    <- as.data.frame(t(g_genus_clr),  check.names = FALSE)
 
 # 把 SeqID 加回去
 micro_counts <- micro_counts %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("SeqID")
 micro_ra     <- micro_ra     %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("SeqID")
 micro_clr    <- micro_clr    %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("SeqID")
 
 # 合并 metadata（建模用）
 dat_counts <- meta_si %>% left_join(micro_counts, by = "SeqID")
 dat_ra     <- meta_si %>% left_join(micro_ra,     by = "SeqID")
 dat_clr    <- meta_si %>% left_join(micro_clr,    by = "SeqID")
 
 ## 11) 保存（可选）
 # write.table(g_genus_filt, "SI_genus_counts_filt.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE)
 # write.table(dat_clr,      "SI_meta_plus_genus_CLR.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
 
 # 过滤不随着时间变化的
 
 library(dplyr)
 library(tidyr)
 library(purrr)
 library(broom)
 
 meta_cols  <- c("SeqID","Year","type")
 genus_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dat_clr), meta_cols)
 
 df <- dat_clr %>% mutate(YearF = factor(Year))
 
 long <- df %>%
   select(all_of(meta_cols), YearF, all_of(genus_cols)) %>%
   pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genus_cols),
                names_to = "genus", values_to = "clr")
 
 res_aov <- long %>%
   group_by(genus) %>%
   summarise(
     p = {
       fit <- lm(clr ~ YearF)
       aov_tab <- anova(fit)               # base R
       aov_tab["YearF", "Pr(>F)"]          # 整体检验 YearF
     },
     R2 = {
       fit <- lm(clr ~ YearF)
       summary(fit)$r.squared
     },
     .groups = "drop"
   ) %>%
   mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
   arrange(FDR)
 
 # 过滤（根据数据量，阈值可调）
 sig_time <- res_aov %>% filter(FDR < 0.1, R2 >= 0.05)
 nrow(sig_time)
 
 dat_clr_time <- dat_clr %>%
   select(all_of(meta_cols), all_of(sig_time$genus))
 
 ncol(dat_clr_time) # 924 genus
 
 
 # 代谢物
 df_m <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "metabo_re", "2_28", "meta_in_all.txt"),
                    row.names = 1, sep = '\t',header = T,stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
 
 
 library(dplyr)
 library(tidyr)
 library(stringr)
 
 
 ## 1) 准备 genus 样本信息：只保留 SeqID + Year（来自 dat_clr_time 或 dat_clr）
 # dat_clr_time: 筛过时间变化 genus 后的表（含 SeqID/Year/type + genus列）
 meta_g <- dat_clr_time %>%
   select(SeqID, Year, type) %>%
   mutate(SeqID = as.character(SeqID))
 
 ## 2) 准备 metabolite 表：确保有 SeqID/year 列
 m0 <- df_m %>% as.data.frame()
 
 # 如果 SeqID 在行名（你读入时 row.names=1），先变成列
 m0 <- m0 %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("FID")
 
 # 找到 SeqID 列名
 stopifnot("SeqID" %in% colnames(m0))
 m0 <- m0 %>%
   mutate(SeqID = as.character(SeqID))
 
 # 包含各文件，year 列名可能是 year 或 Year的情况
 year_col <- if ("year" %in% colnames(m0)) "year" else if ("Year" %in% colnames(m0)) "Year" else NA
 stopifnot(!is.na(year_col))
 
 ## 3) 只保留 genus 表里存在的 SeqID，并对齐顺序
 common_ids <- intersect(meta_g$SeqID, m0$SeqID)
 
 meta_g2 <- meta_g %>% filter(SeqID %in% common_ids) %>% arrange(SeqID)
 m1 <- m0 %>% filter(SeqID %in% common_ids) %>% arrange(SeqID)
 
 # 对齐检查
 stopifnot(all(meta_g2$SeqID == m1$SeqID))
 
 ## 4) 只保留分析需要的列：SeqID + year + metabolite features
 meta_cols_m <- c("FID", "SeqID", year_col)
 feat_cols <- setdiff(colnames(m1), meta_cols_m)
 
 # 强制转数值（防止读成字符）
 m1[, feat_cols] <- lapply(m1[, feat_cols, drop=FALSE], function(x) as.numeric(x))
 
 ## 5) 用 factor(year) 做整体差异检验：value ~ YearF
 m1$YearF <- factor(m1[[year_col]])
 
 res_m_aov <- lapply(feat_cols, function(feat) {
   y <- m1[[feat]]
   ok <- is.finite(y) & !is.na(y)
   # 如果缺失太多，直接跳过
   if (sum(ok) < 10) return(data.frame(feature=feat, p=NA, R2=NA, n=sum(ok)))
   fit <- lm(y[ok] ~ m1$YearF[ok])
   a <- anova(fit)
   data.frame(
     feature = feat,
     p = a["m1$YearF[ok]", "Pr(>F)"],
     R2 = summary(fit)$r.squared,
     n = sum(ok)
   )
 }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
   mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, method="BH")) %>%
   arrange(FDR)
 
 ## 6) 过滤：同 genus 一样的逻辑（阈值可调）
 sig_m <- res_m_aov %>% filter(!is.na(FDR), FDR < 0.5, R2 >= 0.05)
 nrow(sig_m)
 
 
 # 先看看 R2 分布
 summary(res_m_aov$R2)
 quantile(res_m_aov$R2, c(.5,.7,.8,.9,.95), na.rm=TRUE)
 
 # 推荐：取 R2 >= 0.05 的 top（现在是 287 个）
 sig_m <- res_m_aov %>% filter(!is.na(R2), R2 >= 0.05)
 
 # 或者如果想更少一点：取 top 15% / 10%
 cut <- quantile(res_m_aov$R2, 0.90, na.rm=TRUE)  # top 10%
 sig_m <- res_m_aov %>% filter(!is.na(R2), R2 >= cut)
 nrow(sig_m)
 
 
 ## 7) 输出过滤后的 metabolite table（按 SeqID）

X <- as.matrix(g2[, genus_cols, drop=FALSE])  # n × 924
M <- as.matrix(m2[, met_cols,   drop=FALSE])  # n × 242

# 可选：确保数值型
storage.mode(X) <- "double"
storage.mode(M) <- "double"


fit_one_met <- function(j, M, X, YearF, met_name, genus_names) {
  y <- M[, j]
  ok <- is.finite(y)
  y <- y[ok]
  Yr <- YearF[ok]
  Xo <- X[ok, , drop=FALSE]
  
  # 预先构建 Year 的设计矩阵（不含截距）
  Z <- model.matrix(~ Yr)  # 含截距
  # 对每个 genus 单独拟合：y ~ x + Yr
  # 返回 beta_x, p_x, partial_R2（可选）
  
  out <- lapply(seq_along(genus_names), function(i) {
    x <- Xo[, i]
    if (all(!is.finite(x))) return(NULL)
    
    df <- data.frame(y=y, x=x, Yr=Yr)
    fit <- lm(y ~ x + Yr, data=df)
    sm <- summary(fit)
    ct <- coef(sm)
    if (!("x" %in% rownames(ct))) return(NULL)
    
    # p for x
    p <- ct["x","Pr(>|t|)"]
    beta <- ct["x","Estimate"]
    
    # partial R2 for x: (SSE_reduced - SSE_full) / SSE_reduced
    fit0 <- lm(y ~ Yr, data=df)
    sse0 <- sum(resid(fit0)^2)
    sse1 <- sum(resid(fit)^2)
    pR2 <- if (sse0 > 0) (sse0 - sse1) / sse0 else NA_real_
    
    data.frame(
      metabolite = met_name,
      genus = genus_names[i],
      beta = beta,
      p = p,
      partial_R2 = pR2,
      n = length(y)
    )
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

library(future.apply)

    X = X,
    YearF = YearF,
    met_name = met_cols[j],
    genus_names = genus_cols
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

  filter(!is.na(FDR), FDR < 0.2, !is.na(partial_R2), partial_R2 >= 0.01)

nrow(edges_sig)

# 预先把 Y 对 YearF 残差化（一次就够）
y_r <- resid(lm(dat[[Y_name]] ~ dat$YearF))

med_perm_one <- function(x, m, dat, y_r, P = 500) {
  # 残差化 X 和 M（控制 YearF）
  x_r <- resid(lm(dat[[x]] ~ dat$YearF))
  m_r <- resid(lm(dat[[m]] ~ dat$YearF))
  
  # a 路径
  fit_a <- lm(m_r ~ x_r)
  a <- coef(fit_a)[2]
  
  # b 路径（控制 x_r）
  fit_b <- lm(y_r ~ x_r + m_r)
  b <- coef(fit_b)["m_r"]
  
  T_obs <- a * b
  
  # 置换：打乱 x_r（Freedman–Lane 风格残差置换）
  # 保持 m_r 与 y_r 不变，破坏 x->m 与 x->y 的关联
  T_perm <- numeric(P)
  n <- length(x_r)
  
  for (i in seq_len(P)) {
    xp <- x_r[sample.int(n, n, replace = FALSE)]
    ap <- coef(lm(m_r ~ xp))[2]
    bp <- coef(lm(y_r ~ xp + m_r))["m_r"]
    T_perm[i] <- ap * bp
  }
  
  p <- (1 + sum(abs(T_perm) >= abs(T_obs), na.rm = TRUE)) / (P + 1)
  
  data.frame(
    x = x, m = m,
    a = a, b = b,
    indirect = T_obs,
    p_ind = p
  )
}

y_r <- resid(lm(dat[[Y_name]] ~ dat$YearF))

# 5) 单条边：Freedman–Lane 残差置换检验 
med_perm_one <- function(x, m, dat, y_r, P = 1000) {
  x_r <- resid(lm(dat[[x]] ~ dat$YearF))
  m_r <- resid(lm(dat[[m]] ~ dat$YearF))
  
  a <- coef(lm(m_r ~ x_r))[2]
  b <- coef(lm(y_r ~ x_r + m_r))["m_r"]
  T_obs <- a * b
  
  n <- length(x_r)
  T_perm <- numeric(P)
  
  for (i in seq_len(P)) {
    xp <- x_r[sample.int(n, n, replace = FALSE)]
    ap <- coef(lm(m_r ~ xp))[2]
    bp <- coef(lm(y_r ~ xp + m_r))["m_r"]
    T_perm[i] <- ap * bp
  }
  
  p <- (1 + sum(abs(T_perm) >= abs(T_obs), na.rm = TRUE)) / (P + 1)
  
  data.frame(
    y = Y_name,
    x = x, m = m,
    a = a, b = b,
    indirect = T_obs,
    p_ind = p
  )
}

# list endpoints that were NOT labeled (top -> bottom order on plot) 
hidden_endpoints <- endpoint_nodes2 %>%
  mutate(Endpoint = factor(Endpoint, levels = levels(plot_dat$Endpoint))) %>%
  filter(label == "" | is.na(label)) %>%
  arrange(Endpoint) %>%
  pull(Endpoint) %>%
  as.character()

cat("\nHidden endpoints (top -> bottom):\n")
print(hidden_endpoints)

endpoint_list <- endpoint_nodes2 %>%
  mutate(Endpoint = factor(Endpoint, levels = levels(plot_dat$Endpoint))) %>%
  arrange(Endpoint) %>%
  transmute(
    Endpoint = as.character(Endpoint),
    prop = prop,
    shown = label != ""
  )

cat("\nAll endpoints (top -> bottom):\n")
print(endpoint_list)


ggsave(filename = file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "mediation", "mediation.pdf"),width = 10, height = 5)


# 只展示figure 1中变化的endpoints
# D50,Ks,C, N, EC, K, Ca, Mg, Fe, Ti, Zn, Ni,Co, Cr, Cd, Ba

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(ggnewscale)

# 0) load 
df <- read.delim(
  file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "mediation", "all_top_mediation.txt"),
  sep = "\t", header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# fix empty/duplicate colnames
bad <- which(is.na(names(df)) | names(df) == "")
if (length(bad) > 0) names(df)[bad] <- paste0("XEMPTY_", seq_along(bad))
names(df) <- make.unique(names(df))

#  0b) keep only selected endpoints 
keep_y <- c("D50","Ks","C","N","EC","K","Ca","Mg","Fe","Ti","Zn","Ni","Co","Cr","Cd","Ba")
df <- df %>% filter(y %in% keep_y)

# 1) keep Top N edges per endpoint 
N <- 30
df_small <- df %>%
  group_by(y) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(indirect), n = N, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

#  2) collapse low-frequency phylum (<10) to "Other phyla" 
phy_cnt <- df_small %>% count(x_phylum, name = "n_phy")
low_phy <- phy_cnt %>% filter(n_phy < 10) %>% pull(x_phylum)

#  2b) collapse low-frequency superclass (<10) to "Other superclasses" 
super_cnt <- df_small %>% count(m_superclass, name = "n_super")
low_super <- super_cnt %>% filter(n_super < 10) %>% pull(m_superclass)

df2 <- df_small %>%
  mutate(
    Domain     = x_domain,
    Phylum     = ifelse(x_phylum %in% low_phy, "Other phyla", x_phylum),
    Superclass = ifelse(m_superclass %in% low_super, "Other superclasses", m_superclass),
    Endpoint   = y,
    w_raw      = abs(indirect)
  )

plot_dat <- df2 %>%
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Superclass, Endpoint) %>%
  summarise(w = sum(w_raw, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(is.finite(w), w > 0) %>%
  mutate(w = sqrt(w))

#  3) endpoint grouping (4 classes) 
grp_physical <- c("D50","Ks","C","N")
grp_nutrient <- c("Fe","Ti","Zn","Ni","Co","Cr","Cd","Ba")
grp_ion_salt <- c("EC","K","Ca","Mg")

plot_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  mutate(
    Endpoint_chr  = as.character(Endpoint),
    EndpointGroup = case_when(
      Endpoint_chr %in% grp_physical ~ "Physical",
      Endpoint_chr %in% grp_nutrient ~ "Nutrients",
      Endpoint_chr %in% grp_ion_salt ~ "Ions/Salinity",
      TRUE                           ~ "Rock-derived metals"
    )
  )

endpoint_group_cols <- c(
  "Physical"            = "#8DA0CB",
  "Nutrients"           = "#66C2A5",
  "Ions/Salinity"       = "#FC8D62",
  "Rock-derived metals" = "#CAB2D6"
)

#  4) factor orders 
domain_order <- c("Bacteria","Archaea","Eukaryota")
plot_dat$Domain <- factor(plot_dat$Domain, levels = domain_order[domain_order %in% unique(plot_dat$Domain)])

# phylum
phylum_levels <- unique(as.character(plot_dat$Phylum))
phylum_levels <- c(setdiff(phylum_levels, "Other phyla"), "Other phyla")
plot_dat$Phylum <- factor(plot_dat$Phylum, levels = phylum_levels)

# superclass
superclass_order <- c(
  "Organoheterocyclic compounds",
  "Lipids and lipid-like molecules",
  "Benzenoids",
  "Phenylpropanoids and polyketides",
  "Organic acids and derivatives",
  "Organic nitrogen compounds",
  "Organic oxygen compounds",
  "Alkaloids and derivatives",
  "Nucleosides, nucleotides, and analogues",
  "Lignans, neolignans and related compounds",
  "Unclassified",
  "Other superclasses"
)
superclass_order <- superclass_order[superclass_order %in% unique(plot_dat$Superclass)]
superclass_order <- c(superclass_order, setdiff(unique(plot_dat$Superclass), superclass_order))
plot_dat$Superclass <- factor(plot_dat$Superclass, levels = superclass_order)

# endpoint
endpoint_order <- keep_y
endpoint_order <- endpoint_order[endpoint_order %in% unique(plot_dat$Endpoint)]
endpoint_order <- c(endpoint_order, setdiff(unique(plot_dat$Endpoint), endpoint_order))
plot_dat$Endpoint <- factor(plot_dat$Endpoint, levels = endpoint_order)

# 5) colors 
domain_cols <- c(Archaea="#B8B2D9", Bacteria="#8FB3DD", Eukaryota="#C7C7C7")
domain_cols <- domain_cols[names(domain_cols) %in% levels(plot_dat$Domain)]

super_cols <- c(
  "Organoheterocyclic compounds"="#F3B670",
  "Lipids and lipid-like molecules"="#CCBCD9",
  "Benzenoids"="#8EC585",
  "Phenylpropanoids and polyketides"="#F9F1D6",
  "Organic acids and derivatives"="#B1D0E3",
  "Organic nitrogen compounds"="#DEE4D2",
  "Organic oxygen compounds"="#ECDDE4",
  "Alkaloids and derivatives"="#8c6bb1",
  "Nucleosides, nucleotides, and analogues"="#80cdc1",
  "Lignans, neolignans and related compounds"="#a6bddb",
  "Unclassified"="#f8bbd0",
  "Other superclasses"="#E0E0E0"
)
super_cols <- super_cols[names(super_cols) %in% levels(plot_dat$Superclass)]
miss_super <- setdiff(levels(plot_dat$Superclass), names(super_cols))
if (length(miss_super) > 0) super_cols <- c(super_cols, setNames(rep("#cccccc", length(miss_super)), miss_super))

phylum_base <- setNames(rep("#f0f0f0", length(levels(plot_dat$Phylum))), levels(plot_dat$Phylum))
phylum_key_cols <- c(
  "Actinobacteria"   = "#8AC2B3",
  "Proteobacteria"   = "#FB8072",
  "Cyanobacteria"    = "#80B1D3",
  "Bacteroidetes"    = "#FDEE74",
  "Firmicutes"       = "#AFACCF",
  "Planctomycetes"   = "#C5E2B6",
  "Chloroflexi"      = "#979B3C",
  "Verrucomicrobia"  = "#848CC5",
  "Other phyla"      = "#BDBDBD"
)
phylum_key_cols <- phylum_key_cols[names(phylum_key_cols) %in% levels(plot_dat$Phylum)]
phylum_cols <- phylum_base
phylum_cols[names(phylum_key_cols)] <- phylum_key_cols

# endpoint nodes (for endpoint stratum + labels)
endpoint_nodes <- plot_dat %>%
  group_by(Endpoint, EndpointGroup) %>%
  summarise(w = sum(w), .groups = "drop")

# label filter (optional)
endpoint_label_min_prop <- 0.02
endpoint_nodes2 <- endpoint_nodes %>%
  mutate(
    prop  = w / sum(w),
    label = ifelse(prop >= endpoint_label_min_prop, as.character(Endpoint), "")
  )

# 6) plot 
ggplot(
  plot_dat,
  aes(axis1 = Domain, axis2 = Phylum, axis3 = Superclass, axis4 = Endpoint, y = w)
) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Domain","Phylum","Superclass","Endpoint"),
    expand = c(0.18, 0.18)
  ) +
  
  # flows colored by Superclass
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Superclass), alpha = 0.45, width = 1/28, knot.pos = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = super_cols, guide = "none") +
  
  # Domain
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_stratum(aes(x = 1, stratum = Domain, fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 1/10, color = "white", size = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = domain_cols, guide = "none") +
  
  # Phylum
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_stratum(aes(x = 2, stratum = Phylum, fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 1/10, color = "white", size = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_cols, guide = "none") +
  
  # Superclass
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_stratum(aes(x = 3, stratum = Superclass, fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 1/10, color = "white", size = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = super_cols, guide = "none") +
  
  # labels for col 1~3 (black)
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = ifelse(after_stat(x) < 4, as.character(after_stat(stratum)), "")),
    size = 4, color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Endpoint stratum (group colors)
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_stratum(
    data = endpoint_nodes,
    aes(x = 4, stratum = Endpoint, y = w, fill = EndpointGroup),
    width = 1/10, color = "white", size = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = endpoint_group_cols, guide = "none") +
  
  # Endpoint labels (filtered)
  geom_text(
    data = endpoint_nodes2,
    aes(x = 4, stratum = Endpoint, y = w, label = label),
    stat = "stratum",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4, color = "black",
    hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.05
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 80, 10, 20)
  )


endpoint_list <- endpoint_nodes2 %>%
  mutate(Endpoint = factor(Endpoint, levels = levels(plot_dat$Endpoint))) %>%
  arrange(Endpoint) %>%
  transmute(
    Endpoint = as.character(Endpoint),
    prop = prop,
    shown = label != ""
  )

cat("\nAll endpoints (top -> bottom):\n")
print(endpoint_list)
```
